notes: UI patch nho: dong bo visual nut/card 'PHF HR' o Classroom (header .phfc-hub-back va sidebar/mobile drawer .phfc-sidebar-hub-back) voi ngon ngu thiet ke Checklist. Khong doi bo cuc/kich thuoc/cau truc icon+text/responsive, khong doi component structure. Doi mau: border-color -> #b7d0bf (tong Checklist .phfck-secondary border), hover border/background -> #8fbf9e/#f7fbf5, icon circle -> nen #edf7e9 (Checklist --phfck-green-soft) + chu #005642 (Checklist --phfck-green), chu 'PHF HR' -> #005642 (truoc la #0b6238/#184f39 - mau mint/xanh la rieng, khong khop token Checklist). Subtitle 'He sinh thai phat trien nhan su' -> 'Ve Trang chu PHF HR' (wording dieu huong ro hon, khong anh huong layout, van 1 dong). Icon glyph tu '<-' doi thanh '(nha)' vi trace xac nhan action thuc te la goHub() -> location.assign(role-based '/home' route co dinh, KHONG dung history.back() - icon Back truoc do khong dung ngu nghia voi hanh vi Home co dinh; giu nguyen goHub()/route/permission/data/auth khong doi. File sua: assets/js/classroom/phf-classroom-app.js (2 cho: header + sidebar mobile, chi doi ky tu icon + text subtitle), assets/css/phf-classroom.css (them 1 khoi CSS override mau cuoi file, khong xoa/sua rule cu).
